plots.reading: Checked linear plus diagnostic applies are shown separately from the named telemetry JVP overhead; this is not a duration plot.
Only unpreconditioned true-residual observations are plotted; projected residuals remain advisory and are not used here.
Each bar is the uncapped maximum of the exact Euclidean INV-K0-013 ratio for one cell.
Angles use the pre-solve retained RHS prefix, so the plot does not show nested-space self-overlap.
Accepted and rejected counts are preserved outputs of the frozen controller; telemetry does not feed the decision path.
